title: StoryRequest
description: Document story_requests/story_{session_id} (SDD 8, 11): the Reading Coach's queue_story request. Producer of the request fields: Reading Coach (W3), written before it publishes plan.ready. Consumer: Passage Generator (W2), which handles plan.ready, generates the child's next passage within a 60 s bound and with no bank fallback, then adds status, passage_id (DONE only) and processed_at and sets children/{child_id}.next_passage_id (a FAILED request, or no request, clears it instead, so a child never reads the same story twice). Idempotent: a request that already has a status (DONE or FAILED) is skipped. The passage_id of a pre-generated passage is gen_next_{session_id}, so it never equals this document's own id (story_{session_id}) or the in-session passage of the same session (gen_{session_id}). tags always holds one or two different tags: with none to send, the Coach writes no request.
